reranked_evidence.title: Shajan Skaria vs. The State of Kerala and Ors. (23.08.2024
reranked_evidence.snippet: and Radha Shyam Jena, AOR Case Category: CRIMINAL MATTERS - CRIMINAL MATTERS RELATING TO BAIL/INTERIM BAIL/ANTICIPATORY BAIL AND AGAINST SUSPENSION OF SENTENCE Case Note: Criminal -Anticipatory bail -Bar thereto - Sections 3(1)(r),3(1)(u) and 18 of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes Act, 1989 and Sections 41A, 60 and 438 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 - Appellant published video on online video sharing platform, levelling certain allegations against complainant -Complainant aggrieved by publication of said video, filed written complaint alleged that video was published by Appellant in order to publicise, abuse and insult complainant, who was member of Scheduled Caste - First Information Report was lodged by complainant (Respondent No. 2) for offence punishable under Sections 3(1)(r) and 3(1)(u) of Act - Apprehending his arrest, Appellant went before Court of Special Judge for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes for grant of anticipatory bail under Section 438 of Code which was rejected holding that bar of Section 18 of Act prohibit court from exercising powers under Section 438 of Code - Appellant challenged order passed by Special Judge before High Court wherein High Court refused to grant anticipatory bail to Appellant - Hence, present appeal - Whether Section 18 of Act, 1989 imposes absolute bar on grant of anticipatory bail in cases registered under said Act and averments in FIR/complaint disclose commission of any offence under Section 3(1)(r) and 3(1)(u) of Act. Facts: The Appellant published a video on an online video sharing platform, levelling certain allegations against the complainant.
